nodes.label: GET /check-session
nodes.rationale: Silent auth check via iframe without full redirect.

nodes.label: POST /logout
nodes.rationale: Optional user_id scopes logout to one account or all sessions; empty session deletes the session cookie.

nodes.label: User Management API Endpoints
nodes.rationale: CRUD endpoints under /api/users require JWT Bearer token with super_admin (write) or admin (read) role.

nodes.label: GET /authorize
nodes.rationale: Entry point of the OAuth flow; state parameter required for CSRF protection; code_challenge required for public clients.

nodes.label: Rate Limiting
nodes.rationale: Login limited to 5 attempts/15 min per email; /token limited to 20 req/min per IP.

nodes.label: POST /revoke
nodes.rationale: RFC 7009 token revocation for access or refresh tokens; always returns 200 to avoid exposing errors.

nodes.label: POST /token
nodes.rationale: Must be called server-side; exchanges authorization code for tokens; redirect_uri must exactly match /authorize.

nodes.label: POST /token/refresh
nodes.rationale: Refresh token becomes invalid immediately after use (rotation).

nodes.label: access_token (JWT RS256)
nodes.rationale: Used to call /userinfo and resource APIs; lifetime 1 hour.

nodes.label: refresh_token (opaque, rotated)
nodes.rationale: Rotated on every use; reuse of an old token revokes the entire token family for that user's app.

nodes.label: league/oauth2-client (PHP)
nodes.rationale: Standard OAuth2 client for PHP/Laravel; base version has no built-in PKCE support (public clients need manual PKCE) and does not verify id_token automatically.

nodes.label: Role Hierarchy (super_admin/admin/member)
nodes.rationale: Only super_admin can CRUD users and is never selectable from UI (set via API/seeder); admin is read-only for users; member manages only own apps.

nodes.label: Redirect URI Rules
nodes.rationale: Exact-match verification, https required for production (localhost/127.0.0.1 allowed for dev), no URL fragments per RFC 6749, no wildcards.

nodes.label: Confidential Client
nodes.rationale: Apps with a backend server (Node, Go, PHP, Python) that can safely store a client_secret; PKCE optional.

nodes.label: PKCE
nodes.rationale: Mandatory for public clients (SPA/mobile that cannot keep a secret), optional but recommended for confidential clients; S256 method recommended.

nodes.label: Public Client
nodes.rationale: SPA/mobile apps that cannot store a secret; PKCE mandatory.

nodes.label: Admin — Kelola User
nodes.rationale: User management page restricted to admin/super_admin; users are soft-deleted (kept in DB, hidden from list); password not editable — reset requires delete+recreate or a dedicated endpoint.

nodes.label: Developer Console
nodes.rationale: Web UI for registering/managing OAuth apps; accounts only created by admin/super_admin — no self-registration. JWT stored in localStorage after login.

nodes.label: client_secret shown only once
nodes.rationale: Secret displayed once at creation; regenerate invalidates the old secret immediately, breaking all instances still using it.

nodes.label: sso-docs Docs Service
nodes.rationale: Production container serving the documentation site on port 3000 (configurable via PORT env), restart unless-stopped, NODE_ENV=production.

nodes.label: GET /.well-known/jwks.json
nodes.rationale: Public key for local RS256 JWT verification without connecting to SSO.

nodes.label: Authorization Code Flow
nodes.rationale: Chosen because it is the standard OAuth 2.0 flow used by Google/GitHub; the client app never sees the user's password — the SSO handles authentication and issues tokens as proof.

nodes.label: id_token (JWT RS256)
nodes.rationale: OIDC identity verification; verifiable locally against SSO public key (JWKS), no network call needed; iss must be https://sso.doscom.org and aud the client_id.

nodes.label: ssoauth Go Package
nodes.rationale: Official Go client for DOSCOM SSO; handles PKCE, state, token exchange, JWT verification via JWKS (cached keys), and refresh. Lives in the same repo as the SSO server.

nodes.label: openid-client (Node.js)
nodes.rationale: Full OAuth2/OIDC implementation for Node.js; performs auto-discovery from /.well-known/openid-configuration so all endpoint URLs are picked up automatically.

nodes.label: firebase/php-jwt
nodes.rationale: Companion library used to verify id_token against SSO JWKS since league/oauth2-client does not verify id_tokens itself.

nodes.label: authlib (Python)
nodes.rationale: Full OAuth2/OIDC library for Django/Flask/FastAPI; with server_metadata_url it auto-discovers endpoints and JWKS and verifies id_token (signature, issuer, audience, expiry) automatically.

nodes.label: DOSCOM SSO
nodes.rationale: Single Sign-On server built on OAuth 2.0 + OIDC so integrations are language-agnostic (HTTP + standard JWT only, no password handling by client apps).
